web_rules.authorization: Q24; parent explicitly confirmed group stacking and self-candidate rule in this batch

source_eligible.native_default_basis: YDWE MiscGame flags are comparison data, not proven client defaults; adopting them here is Q24
source_eligible.global_pause: simulation time stops so no mana accumulation

require: same owner or source owner has ally relationship toward recipient owner
recipient_eligible.no_mana: can carry informational aura buff; positive gain is0 if maxMana0, never creates mana pool

aggregation.within_group: max candidate, not sum; ties smallest stable sourceId for provenance only
aggregation.self_multiplier: only candidate emitted by recipient itself; does not multiply allied aura candidates, I230, INT regeneration, items or instant mana gains

lifecycle.mode: event reactive, no aura pulse and no linger (Q24)
lifecycle.event_order: integrate previous resolved rate over elapsed simulation time first, then mutate state, recompute candidates before next observable operation at that timestamp; B05 same-time queue order preserved
lifecycle.movement_boundary: evaluate at authoritative movement position update; no retroactive payout for movement intervals before an entry update
lifecycle.source_lost: remove that candidate immediately; fall back to next eligible same-group source in same operation
lifecycle.recipient_lost: remove both group buff records immediately; no death carryover
lifecycle.buffs: one informational B022 iff A018 group>0, one B054 iff I230 group>0; no hidden duplicate bonus on repeated scans
lifecycle.dispel: ordinary dispel does not clear universal aura eligibility; explicit rawcode removal clears record then synchronous reconciliation reapplies if source eligible
lifecycle.revival: re-evaluate live sources, no persisted old buff expiry
lifecycle.form_preservation: same entity H004->G039 keeps learned rank but recomputes once; if a transform truly removes capability its aura ends; never infer enable solely from original unit type

mana_interface.order: compute other resolved mana regeneration separately, then add this channel; this scoped flat channel is not multiplied by generic percent-regeneration modifiers
mana_interface.rounding: no integer truncation per tick; retain fractions; no banked overflow at maxMana
mana_interface.instant_events: skill mana costs/gains preserve existing queue/call order; aura tick is not a spell cast/damage event; no damage pipeline/equipment proc callback

web_rules.save: persist actual ability ranks/enabled flags, identity, transform state, positions, owners/alliance, eligibility flags, fractional mana and simulation time; reconstruct aura candidates without payouts; optional cached rates must agree, no duplicate accumulation
